releases.name: Code Velocity
releases.summary:
Code Velocity is a cute chibi-style casual competitive typing game. Players can play as cops or thieves, with movement speed determined by their typing speed and accuracy.

In real-time matchups, use props, compete for vehicles, and experience intense chase showdowns!

releases.name: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO
Roman Sands RE:Build
releases.summary:
Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. 

There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

Roman Sands RE:Build is a delirium-charged journey into apocalypse which collides through visual novel, adventure, puzzle solving, horror, and survival simulation.

releases.name: Welcome To Mars 9
releases.summary:
Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River is a classic-style graphic adventure about a person adrift in space who is rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you'll immerse yourself in a world of comfort and pleasure - until you realize the station hides a dark secret.

In Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River, you'll navigate the station's lavish leisure facilities, using your wits to solve puzzles and move forward. As the story unfolds, you’ll begin to uncover the sinister side of the station and must choose whether to ignore it or take action.

The choices you make in Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River will challenge your ethics and test your morality. 

Will you do whatever it takes to protect yourself and survive, or risk everything to expose the truth and stop what's happening on board?

releases.name: Bible Quiz Trivia - Do you know your Bible?
releases.summary: Test your Bible knowledge in a fun multiplayer quiz with your family, friends, and church group! Up to 8 players answer with their phones, while the game runs on your PC. Pick your categories, choose the difficulty, add AI opponents, and discover fun Bible facts as you play.

releases.name: Mars 2099
releases.summary: Defend humanity's first Mars colony in this fast-paced modern arcade space shooter. Battle asteroid storms, hostile UFOs, complete challenging missions, and master skill-based gameplay inspired by the golden age of arcade classics.
